sloka: दैत्यानां किल धर्मज्ञ पुरीयं सवनार्णवा ।सपर्वता मही वीर ते ऽभवन्प्रभविष्णवः ।। ७.११.१७ ॥
transliteration: daityānāṁ kila dharmajña purīyaṁ savanārṇavā ।saparvatā mahī vīra te 'bhavanprabhaviṣṇavaḥ ।। 7.11.17 ॥

translations.english: O knower of Dharma and O hero, this entire earth, with its forests, oceans, and mountains, was indeed the realm of the powerful Daityas.
